name: prompt-studio
title: Prompt Studio
description: Find and reuse prompts across coding tools
author: alex_grama

preferences.name: libraryDirectory
preferences.title: Prompt Directory
preferences.description: Absolute path or ~/ path containing Prompt Studio Markdown files

preferences.name: qmdExecutable
preferences.title: QMD Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to qmd; conventional macOS install paths are detected automatically

preferences.name: projectRoots
preferences.title: Project Roots
preferences.description: Folders Prompt Studio may scan for saved Git repositories; you can also choose one exact repo directly in Enhance Prompt

preferences.name: sshProjectRoot
preferences.title: Mac Mini Project Root
preferences.description: Optional read-only SSH source in host:path form; leave blank to disable

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: Shared encrypted preference for Enhance Prompt and Idea Studio; read only after an explicit OpenAI action

commands.name: browse-prompts
commands.title: Prompt Studio
commands.description: Find, preview, copy, and save prompts

commands.name: enhance-prompt
commands.title: Enhance Prompt
commands.description: Turn an idea into a complete prompt when enhancement is activated

commands.name: idea-studio
commands.title: Idea Studio
commands.description: Capture, queue, paste, complete, and reuse AI work

commands.name: quick-capture
commands.title: Quick Capture
commands.description: Save selected or clipboard text to Idea Studio immediately

commands.name: menubar-prompts
commands.title: Most-Used Prompts
commands.description: Copy your most-used prompts from the macOS menubar

scripts.lint: eslint src test evals/*.mts cli/*.mts mcp/*.mts scripts/*.mts --max-warnings=0
scripts.fix-lint: eslint src test evals/*.mts cli/*.mts mcp/*.mts scripts/*.mts --fix
scripts.check:store: pnpm test:store-core && pnpm package:store && npm --prefix dist-store ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix dist-store run lint && npm --prefix dist-store run build
scripts.publish:store: pnpm package:store && npm --prefix dist-store ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix dist-store run publish
scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm build:cli && pnpm build:mcp && pnpm verify:mcp-runtime && pnpm verify:mcp-bundle && pnpm verify:mcp-mutations && pnpm verify:feedback-cli && pnpm verify:optimization-cli
